listening.imageAlt: Một người đang bấm máy tính cầm tay, trước mặt là laptop hiển thị bảng tính và một chậu cây

audio.text: A woman is using a calculator.
A woman is signing a check.
A laptop is being carried.
Some papers are being shredded.

options: A woman is using a calculator.
A woman is signing a check.

why.vi: Tay cô ấy đang bấm máy tính cầm tay: is using a calculator. Laptop chỉ để trên bàn.
why.en: Her hand is on the calculator, so (A) is correct. The laptop is simply on the desk.

questions.trap: Câu (C) lấy laptop làm bẫy, nhưng không ai đang xách nó.

listening.imageAlt: Nhiều con sứa tròn nhỏ màu xanh trôi rải rác trong nước tối

audio.text: Some coins have been scattered on a table.
A net is being lowered into the water.
Some lights are being turned off.
Some small jellyfish are floating in the water.

options: Some coins have been scattered on a table.
A net is being lowered into the water.
Some lights are being turned off.
Some small jellyfish are floating in the water.

why.vi: Ảnh có nhiều sứa nhỏ đang trôi trong nước, nên (D) đúng. Không có lưới hay đồng xu.
why.en: Small jellyfish float in water, so (D) is right. No coins or net appear.

questions.trap: Câu (A) dùng 'scattered' nghe hợp với hình các chấm tròn, nhưng đó là sứa chứ không phải đồng xu.

listening.imageAlt: Một người đàn ông cầm tay kéo của một chiếc xe đẩy gỗ phẳng, bên cạnh là một phụ nữ

audio.text: A woman is pushing a cart.
A man is holding the handle of a cart.
A cart is parked in a garage.
A woman is sweeping the street.

options: A woman is pushing a cart.
A man is holding the handle of a cart.
A cart is parked in a garage.
A woman is sweeping the street.

why.vi: Người đàn ông nắm cán xe đẩy: is holding the handle. Người phụ nữ đứng cạnh, không đẩy xe.
why.en: The man grips the handle, so (B) is correct. The woman stands beside the cart.

questions.trap: Câu (A) giữ đúng vật 'cart' nhưng sai người: người phụ nữ không đẩy xe.

audio.text: Who is giving the keynote speech?
In the main auditorium.
Yes, it was a long speech.
The head of our Seoul branch.

options: Yes, it was a long speech.
The head of our Seoul branch.

why.vi: Who hỏi người; head of the Seoul branch là người.
why.en: 'Who' asks for a person, and the head of the branch is one.

questions.trap: (A) trả lời Where.

audio.text: What's included in the registration fee?
Meals and a conference bag.
By Friday.
It's registered.

why.vi: What hỏi nội dung; 'Meals and a conference bag' trả lời.
why.en: 'What' asks for content, and meals and a bag answer it.

questions.trap: (C) nghe giống registration.

audio.text: Where did you leave the sample products?
Sample size is small.
They're still in my car.
Yes, I like samples.

why.vi: Where hỏi chỗ; 'still in my car' là nơi để.
why.en: 'Where' asks for a place, and 'in my car' is one.

questions.trap: (A) lặp sample nhưng nói cỡ.

audio.text: When is the next staff meeting?
Let me check the calendar.
In the meeting room.
Staff is on leave.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: đi kiểm tra lịch.
why.en: An indirect answer: the speaker will check the calendar.

questions.trap: (B) lặp meeting nhưng là địa điểm.

audio.text: Why is the street closed?
It's a quiet street.
There's a parade today.
Close to the bank.

why.vi: Why hỏi lý do; 'a parade today' là lý do.
why.en: 'Why' asks for a reason, and the parade is one.

questions.trap: (C) nghe giống closed/close.

audio.text: How do I submit my vacation request?
Through the online form.
For ten days.
Yes, I'd like a vacation.

why.vi: How hỏi cách; 'Through the online form' trả lời.
why.en: 'How' asks for a method, and the online form answers it.

questions.trap: (B) trả lời How long.

audio.text: Would you rather work on the budget or the schedule?
The schedule is long.
Yes, I'd rather.
I'm better with numbers.

why.vi: Chọn gián tiếp: giỏi số nên chọn ngân sách.
why.en: An indirect choice: being good with numbers points to the budget.

questions.trap: (A) lặp schedule nhưng không chọn.

audio.text: Do you know if the aquarium café is hiring?
The sign in the window says so.
Hiring costs are rising.
A café hires staff.

options: The sign in the window says so.

why.vi: Dẫn đến biển báo ở cửa sổ: trả lời gián tiếp là có.
why.en: Pointing to the window sign is an indirect yes.

questions.trap: (B) lặp hiring nhưng nói chi phí.

audio.text: I'll need the sales figures by Monday.
Yes, he is figuring it out.
Should I send them by email?
On Monday morning.

options: Yes, he is figuring it out.
Should I send them by email?

why.vi: Hỏi lại cách gửi là phản hồi hợp lý.
why.en: Asking how to send them is a natural reply.

questions.trap: (A) nghe giống figures/figuring.

audio.text: Why don't we hold the training in the afternoon?
A training manual.
Most of the team is out then.
Yes, we trained twice.

options: Most of the team is out then.

why.vi: Từ chối gợi ý bằng lý do: đa số nghỉ buổi chiều.
why.en: The suggestion is rejected with a reason.

questions.trap: (A) lặp training.

audio.text: Who should I talk to about the broken air conditioner?
It's too cold in here.
Building maintenance has a hotline.
Yes, it's air-conditioned.

why.vi: Who hỏi người liên hệ; 'Building maintenance' là bộ phận.
why.en: 'Who' asks whom to contact, and building maintenance is the answer.

questions.trap: (C) lặp air-conditioner.

audio.text: The shipment hasn't arrived and the opening is tomorrow.
I'll arrive by noon.
Yes, it's open all day.
Let's call the carrier for an update.

options: Let's call the carrier for an update.

why.vi: Vấn đề gấp; 'call the carrier' là hướng giải quyết.
why.en: An urgent problem, and calling the carrier is the logical step.

questions.trap: (A) lặp arrive nhưng nói về mình.

audio.text: Hi, Oliver. How was your meeting with the Dalton Group?
It went well. They're interested in our new scheduling software, but they'd like a trial first.
A trial? How long?
Thirty days. I told them that's possible, but I need approval from Ms. Reyes.
I can talk to her this afternoon. She usually agrees if the client is large.
That would help. They have four hundred employees, so it could be a big account.

questions.q: What did the man do earlier?

why.vi: Anh vừa họp với Dalton Group, một khách hàng tiềm năng.
why.en: He met a possible client.

questions.trap: Software là sản phẩm anh bán, không phải việc anh sửa.

questions.q: What does the client request?

why.vi: Họ muốn dùng thử 30 ngày trước.
why.en: A thirty-day trial is a free test period.

questions.trap: Giá chưa được bàn tới.

questions.q: What does the woman offer to do?

why.vi: Cô sẽ nói chuyện với bà Reyes chiều nay.
why.en: She will talk to Ms. Reyes, a manager.

questions.trap: Cô không liên lạc trực tiếp với khách.

audio.text: Excuse me, I'm trying to return a jacket I bought here last week, but I don't have the receipt.
That's all right. Did you pay by credit card?
Yes, with my Zenith card.
Then I can look it up. I just need to see the card and a photo ID.
Here you go. It's a little too small, actually, so I'd like to exchange it for a larger size.
Let me check the stock. Oh, the large is out, but we have the extra-large in the same color.
Hmm, I think that'll be too big. I'll just take the refund, please.

questions.q: What does the man want to do?

why.vi: Anh muốn trả lại chiếc áo khoác.
why.en: He wants to return a jacket.

questions.trap: Credit card chỉ để tra cứu giao dịch.

questions.q: What does the woman need from the man?

why.vi: Cô cần thẻ và giấy tờ có ảnh, tức là thẻ và giấy tờ tùy thân.
why.en: A photo ID is identification.

questions.trap: Receipt là thứ anh không có, nhưng cô nói không cần.

questions.q: What does the man decide to do?

why.vi: Cuối cùng anh chọn nhận tiền hoàn lại.
why.en: He chooses a refund, i.e. money back.

questions.trap: Extra-large anh nói sẽ quá rộng.

audio.text: Rob, have you seen the budget proposal for the Dubai trip?
I looked at it this morning. The hotel costs are higher than I expected.
They're hosting a big trade show that week, so the rates go up.
What if we stay in a different part of the city and take the metro?
That could save about two hundred dollars per person. I'll look into hotels near the airport.
Good. I'll ask the travel agency whether they can find us a group discount.

questions.q: What are the speakers trying to do?

why.vi: Họ tìm cách giảm chi phí chuyến đi (khách sạn đắt).
why.en: They look for ways to save on trip costs.

questions.trap: Trade show là lý do giá tăng, không phải việc họ lên kế hoạch.

questions.q: Why are hotel prices high?
options: A large event is taking place

why.vi: Có một hội chợ thương mại lớn trong tuần đó.
why.en: A big trade show is an event.

questions.trap: Không nhắc đến mùa hè.

questions.q: What will the man do?

why.vi: Anh sẽ hỏi công ty du lịch về giảm giá cho nhóm.
why.en: A group discount is a bulk rate.

questions.trap: Cô là người tìm khách sạn gần sân bay.

audio.text: Ms. Wu, the printer on the fourth floor is jammed again.
That's the second time today. Did you open the rear panel?
Yes, I removed a few pieces of paper, but the display still says error.
Hmm. I think it's time to replace it. It's more than six years old.
The cost might be an issue. Our department's equipment budget is almost used up.
I'll ask the finance team whether we can borrow from next quarter. Meanwhile, please use the printer on the third floor.

questions.q: What problem is mentioned?

why.vi: Máy in tầng bốn lại bị kẹt giấy, tức là máy hoạt động sai.
why.en: The printer jams repeatedly.

questions.trap: Package không được nhắc.

questions.q: What concern does the man raise?

why.vi: Ngân sách thiết bị gần hết, tức là nguồn tiền hạn chế.
why.en: The equipment budget is almost used up.

questions.trap: Delivery chưa tới giai đoạn đó.

questions.q: What will the woman do?

why.vi: Cô sẽ hỏi bộ phận tài chính xem có thể mượn ngân sách quý sau không.
why.en: She will ask the finance team.

questions.trap: Cô không gọi thợ sửa vì đề xuất thay mới.

audio.text: Good afternoon, Greenfield Realty. This is Nina.
Hi, I saw your listing for the two-bedroom apartment on Maple Street. Is it still available?
Yes, it is. It has a balcony and is five minutes from the subway. The rent is nine hundred and fifty dollars a month.
That's within my budget. Are pets allowed?
Small ones, with an extra deposit of one hundred dollars.
I have a cat, so that's fine. Could I see it this weekend?
Certainly. How about Saturday at eleven?

questions.q: What is the man interested in?

why.vi: Anh hỏi về căn hộ cho thuê trên đường Maple.
why.en: He asks about a rental listing.

questions.trap: Rent nghĩa là thuê, không phải mua.

questions.q: What does the woman say about pets?

why.vi: Thú nhỏ được phép nhưng thêm 100 đô tiền cọc.
why.en: A hundred-dollar deposit is an additional fee.

questions.trap: Phí này là tiền cọc một lần, không phải hàng tháng.

questions.q: What will happen on Saturday?

why.vi: Anh sẽ đi xem căn hộ lúc 11 giờ thứ Bảy.
why.en: He will go to see the apartment.

questions.trap: Chưa ký hợp đồng thuê.

audio.text: Sandra, the quarterly newsletter is due Friday, but we're missing the photos from the Singapore event.
Mark said he'd send them last week. Did you ask him again?
I emailed twice. I think his inbox is full.
Why don't you try the shared drive? He sometimes uploads big files there.
Good thought. If they're not there, I'll call him directly.
And if we still don't get them, we can use pictures from the website.

questions.q: What are the speakers concerned about?

why.vi: Họ thiếu ảnh cho bản tin sắp phát hành.
why.en: Photos for the newsletter are missing.

questions.trap: Event ở Singapore đã diễn ra, không bị hủy.

questions.q: What does the woman suggest checking?

why.vi: Cô gợi ý kiểm tra ổ đĩa chung.
why.en: The shared drive is a shared online folder.

questions.trap: Website chỉ là phương án dự phòng cuối.

questions.q: What will the man do if the files are not there?

why.vi: Anh sẽ gọi trực tiếp cho Mark.
why.en: He will call Mark directly.

questions.trap: Anh không viết bài mới.

audio.text: Good evening, and welcome to the Riverside Science Museum. I am Marcus, and tonight I will guide you through our new exhibit on renewable energy. We will start in the Wind Hall, where you can see a working model of a turbine. Please do not touch the model, but feel free to take pictures. Next, we will move on to the Solar Garden, where visitors can test how sunlight turns into electricity. The tour will end in the gift shop, where members receive a twenty percent discount. For those of you who are not members, you can sign up at the information desk for a yearly pass at half price tonight only. Now, if you will follow me, we will begin.

questions.q: Who is the speaker?

why.vi: Anh ấy giới thiệu bản thân và nói sẽ dẫn khách tham quan.
why.en: He says he will guide visitors through an exhibit.

questions.trap: Scientist là bẫy do chủ đề khoa học.

questions.q: What can visitors do in the Solar Garden?

why.vi: Ở Solar Garden khách thử nghiệm ánh sáng mặt trời thành điện.
why.en: Visitors can test how sunlight is turned into electricity.

questions.trap: Wind Hall mới có mô hình tua-bin, không phải Solar Garden.

questions.q: What can non-members do tonight?

why.vi: Chỉ tối nay, thẻ năm giá nửa tiền cho người chưa là hội viên.
why.en: Non-members can sign up for a yearly pass at half price tonight.

questions.trap: Twenty percent chỉ dành cho hội viên mua ở cửa hàng quà tặng.

audio.text: Good morning, everyone, and thank you for coming to the quarterly sales meeting. Before I turn to the figures, I want to share a bit of good news. Our Asia office has increased sales by eighteen percent compared with last quarter, which is the best result in the company. As a result, we will open a second office in Singapore this autumn. This means we will need three experienced managers to relocate. Anyone who is interested should speak with Human Resources by the end of next week. Now, if you look at the handout I have distributed, you will see that sales in our European office were flat. We will discuss some ideas for improving that in the second half of the meeting.

questions.q: What good news does the speaker share?

why.vi: Văn phòng châu Á tăng doanh số 18 phần trăm.
why.en: The Asia office increased sales by eighteen percent.

questions.trap: Europe thì doanh số không đổi, không phải tin tốt.

questions.q: What will the company do this autumn?

why.vi: Mở văn phòng thứ hai ở Singapore vào mùa thu.
why.en: The company will open a second office in Singapore.

questions.trap: Close an old office không có trong bài.

questions.q: What should interested employees do?

why.vi: Ai quan tâm thì liên hệ phòng nhân sự cuối tuần sau.
why.en: Interested employees should speak with Human Resources.

questions.trap: Handout chỉ để xem số liệu, không phải việc đăng ký.

audio.text: And now for the evening traffic report on Radio Ninety-Four. If you are driving home on Highway 7, expect delays of up to forty minutes between exits 12 and 15. A truck lost part of its load earlier this afternoon, and crews are still working to clear the road. Drivers are advised to use Maple Avenue as an alternative route, although it is already busy near the shopping center. On the positive side, the Central Bridge, which was closed for repairs last week, is now open to all vehicles. Public transportation is running on time, and the city is offering free parking at the Eastgate train station this evening. Stay tuned for the weather forecast right after the news.

questions.q: What is the report mainly about?

why.vi: Bản tin nói về kẹt xe và các tuyến đường.
why.en: The report describes traffic and road conditions.

questions.trap: Free parking chỉ là chi tiết, không phải chủ đề chính.

questions.q: What caused the delay on Highway 7?
options: A truck accident with a lost load

why.vi: Xe tải làm rơi một phần hàng nên đường bị tắc.
why.en: A truck lost part of its load.

questions.trap: Central Bridge đã mở lại, nó không phải nguyên nhân tắc đường.

questions.q: What are drivers advised to do?

why.vi: Người lái xe được khuyên đi theo Maple Avenue.
why.en: Drivers are advised to use Maple Avenue.

questions.trap: Cầu Central đã mở nhưng bài không bảo chỉ đi cầu đó.

audio.text: Hello, everyone, and welcome to the Blue Bay Aquarium. I am Linh, and I will lead today's tour of the coral reef gallery. Our first stop is the clownfish tank, where you can watch how the fish live among the sea anemones. After that, we will visit the seahorse nursery. Because the babies are very small, we ask that you speak quietly and keep your hands away from the glass. Our staff feed the animals at eleven thirty, so if you would like to watch, please return to the main hall by that time. The whole tour takes about forty-five minutes. If you enjoy today's visit, please consider leaving a review on our Web site. Now, please gather around to begin.

questions.q: Who most likely are the listeners?

why.vi: Họ là khách tham quan được hướng dẫn đi xem các bể.
why.en: The listeners are visitors on a guided tour.

questions.trap: Trainers là bẫy do chủ đề cho ăn.

questions.q: Why are listeners asked to speak quietly?

why.vi: Vì cá ngựa con rất nhỏ nên cần yên lặng.
why.en: The seahorse babies are very small.

questions.trap: Animals sleeping không được nhắc.

questions.q: What can visitors do at eleven thirty?

why.vi: Nhân viên cho thú ăn lúc 11 giờ 30 và khách có thể xem.
why.en: Staff feed the animals at eleven thirty.

questions.trap: Review trên Web site là việc làm sau chuyến tham quan.

audio.text: Good afternoon, valued customers. Starting next month, the Lakeside Community Bank will introduce a new mobile banking application. With this app, you can check your balance, transfer money, and even deposit checks by taking a photo with your phone. The application will be available for free download on the first of the month. To celebrate the launch, anyone who opens a new savings account in our main branch before the end of the month will receive a twenty-five dollar bonus. Our staff will also be happy to help you set up the app. Please bring your phone and a photo ID to any branch, and we will walk you through the process. Thank you for banking with us.

questions.q: What is being announced?

why.vi: Ngân hàng giới thiệu ứng dụng ngân hàng di động mới.
why.en: The bank introduces a new mobile banking app.

questions.trap: New branch hours không có trong bài.

questions.q: How can customers receive a bonus?

why.vi: Mở tài khoản tiết kiệm mới ở chi nhánh chính sẽ được thưởng 25 đô.
why.en: Opening a savings account earns a twenty-five dollar bonus.

questions.trap: Download app miễn phí nhưng không có thưởng.

questions.q: What does the speaker imply when she says, "we will walk you through the process"?
options: Staff will assist customers with setup.

why.vi: "Walk you through" nghĩa là hướng dẫn từng bước, tức là nhân viên sẽ giúp cài đặt.
why.en: It means staff will guide customers step by step.

questions.trap: Complicated là suy diễn quá đà, bài chỉ nói nhân viên vui lòng giúp.

questions.q: The company's ____ to quality has earned it several awards.

why.vi: Sau sở hữu cách "company's" cần một danh từ: commitment (sự cam kết).
why.en: A noun is needed after the possessive "company's".

questions.trap: Committed là tính từ, không đứng làm chủ ngữ ngay sau sở hữu cách.

questions.q: The new intern worked ____ to finish the inventory before closing.

why.vi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ "worked" cần trạng từ: diligently (chăm chỉ).
why.en: An adverb modifies the verb "worked".

questions.trap: "Diligent" là tính từ, đứng sau worked sẽ hiểu là "tính chất của người", không bổ nghĩa cách làm.

questions.q: By the time the guests arrived, the chefs ____ the main course.

why.vi: "By the time + quá khứ đơn" thì hành động trước đó chia quá khứ hoàn thành: had prepared.
why.en: "By the time" + past simple needs past perfect for the earlier action.

questions.trap: Prepared nghe tự nhiên nhưng không thể hiện món đã xong TRƯỚC khi khách đến.

questions.q: All invoices ____ by the accounting department before payment.

why.vi: Hoá đơn là đối tượng bị xem xét nên dùng bị động: are reviewed.
why.en: Invoices are checked, so the passive "are reviewed" is needed.

questions.trap: "Are reviewing" cho thấy hoá đơn tự đi xem xét ai đó.

questions.q: The candidate ____ we interviewed yesterday has accepted the offer.

why.vi: Chỉ người, làm tân ngữ của interviewed, sau chỗ trống có chủ ngữ "we": dùng whom.
why.en: A person as object, followed by subject "we": "whom".

questions.trap: Whose cần danh từ theo sau, mà sau chỗ trống là "we".

questions.q: Success in this role depends ____ strong communication skills.

why.vi: "Depend on" là cụm cố định: phụ thuộc vào.
why.en: "Depend on" is a fixed collocation.

questions.trap: "Depend of" là lỗi dịch từ tiếng Việt "phụ thuộc vào".

questions.q: The museum has ____ plans to extend its hours this summer.

why.vi: Trước danh từ "plans" dùng "no" để phủ định. "Not" cần đứng trước động từ hoặc tính từ.
why.en: "No" negates the noun "plans".

questions.trap: Has not plans là sai; phải là does not have plans hoặc has no plans.

questions.q: A list of available time slots ____ posted outside the office.

why.vi: Chủ ngữ chính là "A list" (số ít), bỏ qua cụm "of ... slots". Dùng is.
why.en: The head noun "list" is singular, so use "is".

questions.trap: "Slots" nhiều nên em nghĩ are; nhưng nó nằm trong cụm of, không phải chủ ngữ.

questions.q: The tour was canceled ____ the guide became ill.

why.vi: Sau chỗ trống là mệnh đề "the guide became ill", nên dùng liên từ because.
why.en: A clause follows, so "because" is correct.

questions.trap: Because of và due to cùng nghĩa nhưng đòi hỏi danh từ theo sau.

questions.q: Employees may request a refund by completing the ____ form.

why.vi: "Reimbursement form" là cụm danh từ ghép: mẫu đơn hoàn chi phí.
why.en: "Reimbursement form" is a noun + noun phrase.

questions.trap: Reimbursed là V-ed nghe như tính từ, nhưng cụm chuẩn dùng danh từ.

questions.q: This model is ____ of the three laptops we tested.

why.vi: So sánh nhất trong nhóm ba cái, có "of the three", nên dùng the lightest.
why.en: A superlative with "of the three" needs "the lightest".

questions.trap: "Lighter" dùng cho so sánh hai đối tượng.

questions.q: If the supplier had delivered on time, we ____ the deadline.

why.vi: If + quá khứ hoàn thành thì mệnh đề chính là would have + V3 (điều kiện loại 3).
why.en: Third conditional: if + had + V3, would have + V3.

questions.trap: "Would meet" là loại 2, không hợp với "had delivered".

questions.q: Customers ____ in the loyalty program receive a monthly coupon.

why.vi: Khách hàng được ghi danh (bị động), rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ: customers who are enrolled thành customers enrolled.
why.en: Reduced passive relative clause: "customers (who are) enrolled".

questions.trap: Enrolling nghĩa là đang ghi danh người khác, không đúng nghĩa bị động ở đây.

questions.q: Mr. Kim is a highly ____ engineer with ten years of experience.

why.vi: Trước danh từ "engineer", sau trạng từ highly cần tính từ: qualified (có trình độ).
why.en: "Highly" + adjective before the noun "engineer".

questions.trap: "Qualification" là danh từ nên không đứng giữa mạo từ và danh từ như thế.

questions.q: Ms. Wu will present the results ____ at the board meeting.

why.vi: "Herself" nhấn mạnh cô ấy tự trình bày, không nhờ người khác.
why.en: The reflexive "herself" stresses that she presents in person.

questions.trap: "Her" là đại từ tân ngữ, không thể đứng sau results để nhấn mạnh.

passages.title: Riverside Cafe to Open Second Location
passages.text:
Riverside Cafe to Open Second Location

Riverside Cafe, a family-run business known for its handmade pastries, announced on Monday that it will open a second [1] in the Eastgate Shopping Center this fall. The owner, Tamara Silva, said the decision was prompted by growing demand. [2] The new location will seat sixty customers and will [3] a wider menu, including salads and sandwiches. Ms. Silva added that she plans to hire twenty employees, most of [4] will be recruited from the local area.

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: Sau "a second" cần danh từ: "a second location" (cơ sở thứ hai).
why.en: After "a second" we need a noun: "location".

questions.trap: "located" là phân từ nên không đứng được sau "second" làm danh từ.

questions.q: Blank [2]
options: Shopping centers are usually busiest on public holidays.
The original shop has had long lines on most weekends.
Ms. Silva studied business at a university overseas.
The city council plans to build a new bridge.

why.vi: Câu trước nói nhu cầu tăng, câu chèn đưa bằng chứng: hàng dài ở quán gốc.
why.en: The sentence before mentions growing demand, and the missing sentence gives evidence: long lines at the original shop.

questions.trap: Câu A cũng nhắc "shopping center" nhưng không giải thích vì sao nhu cầu tăng.

questions.q: Blank [3]

why.vi: Sau "will" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "will offer".
why.en: After "will" we need a base verb: "offer".

questions.trap: "offering" có thể là danh từ nhưng không đi sau "will".

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: "most of whom" thay cho người, là tân ngữ của giới từ "of".
why.en: "Most of whom" refers to people and is the object of "of".

questions.trap: "who" hay bị chọn nhầm; sau giới từ phải dùng "whom".

passages.title: Damaged lamp
passages.text:
To: Ms. Brandt
From: Harlow Home Supply
Subject: Your damaged lamp

Dear Ms. Brandt,

Thank you for contacting Harlow Home Supply about the damaged lamp you received last week. We are sorry that the package arrived in such poor [1]. [2] Please send us a photo of the damaged item and the packaging so that we can submit a claim to the carrier. Once we have received the photo, we will [3] a replacement lamp at no extra cost. It should arrive within five business days. If you have any further questions, please do not [4] to call our customer service line.

Sincerely,
Harlow Home Supply

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: "in poor condition" là cụm cố định (tình trạng kém).
why.en: "In poor condition" is the fixed collocation.

questions.trap: "conditional" là tính từ nên không đứng sau "poor" như danh từ.

questions.q: Blank [2]
options: Our warehouse will be closed on Monday for inventory.
Lamps in this series are available in three colors.
To resolve the problem, we need some information from you.
Your next order will qualify for a free gift.

why.vi: Câu sau bắt đầu bằng "Please send us a photo", nên câu chèn nêu việc cần thông tin từ khách để giải quyết.
why.en: The next sentence asks for a photo, so the missing sentence explains that information is needed to resolve the issue.

questions.trap: Câu B nhắc "lamp" lặp từ khóa nhưng không dẫn tới yêu cầu gửi ảnh.

questions.q: Blank [3]

why.vi: Sau "we will" cần động từ nguyên mẫu: "ship" (gửi hàng).
why.en: After "we will" we need the base verb "ship".

questions.trap: "shipment" là danh từ nên không đứng sau "will".

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: "do not hesitate to + V" là cụm quen thuộc: đừng ngần ngại gọi.
why.en: "Do not hesitate to + verb" is the familiar phrase.

questions.trap: "hesitant" là tính từ, phải đi sau "be", không đi sau "do not".

passages.title: Store messages
passages.text:
Gina Alvarez (2:14 P.M.): The winter jacket shipment arrived, but the box labeled "Sizes M/L" has only size S.
Ken Watanabe (2:16 P.M.): Seriously? The promotion starts tomorrow.
Gina Alvarez (2:17 P.M.): I know. Should I call the warehouse?
Ken Watanabe (2:19 P.M.): I'll call. You start tagging the other boxes.
Gina Alvarez (2:20 P.M.): Will do. By the way, Ms. Ricci wants a headcount for Saturday's late shift.
Ken Watanabe (2:24 P.M.): The warehouse says the missing jackets will come on tomorrow's 8 A.M. truck.
Gina Alvarez (2:25 P.M.): That works. I'll put the display together once they arrive.
Ken Watanabe (2:26 P.M.): Good. And tell Ms. Ricci I can cover Saturday.

questions.q: What problem do the writers discuss?
options: A shipment contains the wrong sizes
A truck is delayed in traffic

why.vi: Hộp ghi "Sizes M/L" nhưng chỉ có size S.
why.en: The box labeled M/L contains only size S.

questions.trap: Xe tải đến vào 8 giờ sáng mai, chưa bị trễ.

questions.q: At 2:20 P.M., what does Ms. Alvarez mean when she writes, "Will do"?

why.vi: Ngay trước đó anh Ken nói "You start tagging the other boxes", và "Will do" đáp lại lời đó.
why.en: She is responding to Mr. Watanabe telling her to start tagging the other boxes.

questions.trap: Gọi kho là việc anh Ken nhận ("I'll call"), không phải cô Gina.

questions.q: When will the missing jackets arrive?

why.vi: "tomorrow's 8 A.M. truck".
why.en: The warehouse says they will come on tomorrow's 8 A.M. truck.

questions.trap: Thứ Bảy là ca làm muộn, không phải ngày hàng đến.

questions.q: What is suggested about Mr. Watanabe?
options: He is available to work on Saturday

why.vi: Anh nhắn: "tell Ms. Ricci I can cover Saturday", tức anh có thể làm ca thứ Bảy.
why.en: He says he can cover Saturday, so he is available to work then.

passages.title: Sunrise Bakery wins award
passages.text:
HAVERFORD (March 12) - Sunrise Bakery, a family-run business on Mill Street, has been named Small Business of the Year by the Haverford Chamber of Commerce. [1] The award, which is given annually, recognizes companies that show strong growth while supporting the local community. [2] Owner Beatriz Cole opened the bakery eight years ago with only two employees. Today it has 19 and supplies bread to six restaurants in the region. [3] "We never planned to get this big," Ms. Cole said.

In the past year, the bakery has also donated more than 2,000 loaves to local food banks. Ms. Cole credits her staff for the award. "I am the one whose name is on the sign, but they make it work," she said. [4] The Chamber will present the award at its annual dinner on April 5 at the Grand Hotel. Tickets cost $40 and can be reserved through the Chamber's office.

questions.q: What is the article mainly about?
options: A bakery that won a business award

why.vi: Câu đầu: Sunrise Bakery "has been named Small Business of the Year".
why.en: The first sentence reports the bakery was named Small Business of the Year.

questions.q: What does the award recognize?
options: The oldest family business in town
The lowest prices in the region

why.vi: "strong growth while supporting the local community".
why.en: The award recognizes strong growth while supporting the local community.

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Most of those workers were hired within the last three years."

why.vi: "those workers" chỉ 19 nhân viên vừa nhắc ở câu "Today it has 19", nên câu phải đứng ngay sau đó, tại [3].
why.en: "Those workers" refers to the 19 employees mentioned just before position [3].

questions.trap: Vị trí [2] đứng sau câu về "two employees" nhưng chưa có con số 19 để "most of those workers" chỉ vào.

questions.q: According to the article, what has the bakery done in the past year?

why.vi: "donated more than 2,000 loaves to local food banks" trong đoạn hai.
why.en: The second paragraph says it donated more than 2,000 loaves to food banks.

questions.trap: Việc cung cấp bánh cho sáu nhà hàng là tình trạng hiện tại, không gắn với "past year".

passages.title: Elevator project
passages.text:
NOTICE TO ALL TENANTS - Cedar Plaza, 220 Linden Avenue

Elevator Modernization Project

Beginning Monday, May 19, the two passenger elevators will be upgraded one at a time. Elevator 1 will be out of service from May 19 to June 6. Elevator 2 will be out of service from June 9 to June 27. During each period, the other elevator will operate normally.

The freight elevator will remain available for deliveries between 7:00 A.M. and 9:00 A.M. only. Deliveries outside those hours must be arranged with the property manager.

Tenants on floors 8 and above are encouraged to adjust meeting schedules, as waiting times for the elevator may be longer than usual between 8:30 A.M. and 9:30 A.M.

We apologize for any inconvenience. Questions? Contact Dana Whitfield at 555-0172.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
options: To advertise a new tenant service
To inform tenants about elevator upgrades

why.vi: Tiêu đề và đoạn đầu nói về việc nâng cấp thang máy.
why.en: The notice announces the upgrade of the passenger elevators.

questions.q: When will Elevator 2 be out of service?

why.vi: "Elevator 2 will be out of service from June 9 to June 27."
why.en: The notice gives June 9 to June 27 for Elevator 2.

questions.trap: May 19 đến June 6 là thời gian của thang máy số 1.

questions.q: What are tenants on higher floors encouraged to do?

why.vi: "encouraged to adjust meeting schedules".
why.en: They are encouraged to adjust meeting schedules.

questions.trap: Thang hàng chỉ dành cho giao hàng 7:00 đến 9:00.

questions.q: What is suggested about June 4?
options: Both passenger elevators will be unavailable
The freight elevator will be closed
One passenger elevator will be working

why.vi: Ngày 4/6 nằm trong thời gian thang 1 ngừng (19/5 đến 6/6), và thang kia vẫn chạy bình thường.
why.en: June 4 falls in Elevator 1's closure, and the other elevator operates normally.

passages.title: Order #44718
passages.text:
To: Customer Service
From: Walter Chen
Subject: Order #44718
Date: November 4

Dear Customer Service,

On October 21, I ordered a standing desk and a desk lamp from your website. The confirmation e-mail stated that both items would be delivered within 10 business days. The lamp arrived on October 30, but the desk has not.

When I checked the tracking page this morning, it still said "awaiting pickup," which has been the status since October 28. I would appreciate it if you could look into this and tell me when I can expect delivery. If the desk cannot be sent within a week, I would like to cancel that part of my order and receive a refund. A copy of my receipt is attached.

Sincerely,
Walter Chen

questions.q: Why did Mr. Chen write the e-mail?
options: To ask about a late delivery

why.vi: Bàn chưa đến nên anh yêu cầu họ kiểm tra và cho biết ngày giao.
why.en: The desk has not arrived and he asks when to expect delivery.

questions.q: What does Mr. Chen suggest about the tracking information?
options: It has not changed since October 28
It shows the desk was delivered

why.vi: "awaiting pickup" là trạng thái "since October 28", tức không đổi từ đó.
why.en: The status has been "awaiting pickup" since October 28, so it has not been updated.

questions.q: What is NOT indicated about the order?
options: Part of it has been delivered

why.vi: Anh đặt hàng "from your website", không phải qua điện thoại.
why.en: He ordered "from your website," not by telephone.

passages.title: Invoice #2208
passages.text:
INVOICE #2208 - Lakeshore Catering
Date: June 2
Bill to: Davis & Park Law Offices
Event: Staff retirement luncheon, May 29

Buffet lunch (40 guests at $22.00)     $880.00
Beverage service (40 guests at $3.00)  $120.00
Dessert platters (3 at $35.00)         $105.00
Delivery and setup                      $60.00
Subtotal                             $1,165.00
Deposit paid (May 10)                 -$300.00
Balance due                            $865.00

Payment is due by June 16. A 1.5% monthly late fee applies to unpaid balances.

passages.title: Invoice #2208
passages.text:
To: Accounts, Lakeshore Catering
From: Rebecca Park
Date: June 9
Subject: Invoice #2208

Dear Sir or Madam:

I have reviewed the invoice for our retirement luncheon. Thank you for the excellent service; our guests were very pleased. However, I believe there is an error. We ordered the buffet and beverage service for 38 guests, as stated in our confirmation, because two attendees cancelled the day before the event. Also, we ordered only two dessert platters.

Could you please send a corrected invoice? I plan to pay the balance by June 16 as soon as I receive it.

Sincerely,
Rebecca Park

questions.q: Why did Ms. Park write the e-mail?

why.vi: "Could you please send a corrected invoice?"
why.en: She asks for a corrected invoice.

questions.trap: Cô khen dịch vụ ("excellent service"), nên không phải khiếu nại món ăn.

questions.q: What is suggested about the invoice?
options: It is already paid in full
It was sent before the event
It charges for more guests than attended

why.vi: Hóa đơn tính 40 khách, còn email nói chỉ đặt cho 38 khách.
why.en: The invoice bills 40 guests, but Ms. Park says the order was for 38.

questions.trap: Cô đã trả tiền cọc $300 chứ chưa trả hết; số dư vẫn còn.

questions.q: The word "balance" in the e-mail is closest in meaning to

why.vi: Trên hóa đơn "Balance due" là số tiền còn phải trả sau tiền cọc.
why.en: In the invoice, "balance" is the amount still owed after the deposit.

questions.q: When does Ms. Park plan to pay?

why.vi: "I plan to pay the balance by June 16".
why.en: She plans to pay by June 16.

questions.trap: May 10 là ngày đặt cọc.

questions.q: What would the corrected subtotal most likely be?

why.vi: Bớt 2 khách bữa buffet ($44) và đồ uống ($6) cùng một đĩa tráng miệng ($35): 1,165 - 85 = 1,080.
why.en: Removing two guests ($44 plus $6) and one dessert platter ($35) lowers $1,165 by $85 to $1,080.

questions.trap: Chỉ sửa số khách ra $1,121 hoặc chỉ sửa tráng miệng ra $1,130; phải sửa cả hai.

passages.title: Careers at Blue Harbor
passages.text:
Blue Harbor Aquarium | Careers

Guest Experience Coordinator (full-time)

Blue Harbor Aquarium seeks a coordinator to manage school-group and corporate bookings.

Responsibilities: respond to booking inquiries within one business day; prepare group itineraries; work with education staff and keepers; train seasonal front-desk staff.

Requirements: two years of experience in customer service or event coordination; strong written communication; ability to work weekends on a rotating basis. Knowledge of booking software is an advantage.

Salary: $46,000 to $52,000, depending on experience.

To apply, send a cover letter and résumé to careers@blueharbor.example by April 18. Interviews will be held the week of April 28.

passages.title: Application
passages.text:
To: careers@blueharbor.example
From: Linh Bui
Date: April 16
Subject: Guest Experience Coordinator

Dear Hiring Manager,

Please find my cover letter and résumé attached. For the past three years I have worked as a reservations agent at a regional tour company, where I answered inquiries from schools and companies and created itineraries for groups of up to 120. I have also trained several new employees. I am used to working weekends and have used booking software for two years.

I will be traveling from April 28 to May 2, so I would appreciate an interview on a different date if possible.

Sincerely,
Linh Bui

questions.q: Why did Ms. Bui write the e-mail?

why.vi: Cô gửi thư xin việc và hồ sơ cho vị trí Guest Experience Coordinator.
why.en: She sends a cover letter and résumé for the coordinator position.

questions.q: What will the coordinator be asked to do?

why.vi: Trong Responsibilities có "train seasonal front-desk staff".
why.en: Training seasonal front-desk staff is listed among the responsibilities.

questions.q: What requirement does Ms. Bui clearly meet?
options: A previous job at an aquarium
Two years of customer service experience

why.vi: Cô làm đặt chỗ ba năm và trả lời khách hàng, nên đạt yêu cầu hai năm kinh nghiệm.
why.en: Her three years as a reservations agent satisfy the two-year customer service requirement.

questions.trap: Trang tuyển dụng không đòi bằng sinh học biển.

questions.q: What is indicated about Ms. Bui's application?
options: It was sent two days before the deadline
It was sent after the deadline
It was sent on the deadline
It was sent the week of the interviews

why.vi: Hạn nộp là April 18; thư gửi ngày April 16, tức sớm hai ngày.
why.en: The deadline is April 18 and she wrote on April 16.

questions.q: What problem might Ms. Bui have with the interview schedule?
options: She will be traveling that week
She has no booking software experience
She lives far from the aquarium

why.vi: Phỏng vấn tuần April 28, còn cô đi xa từ April 28 đến May 2.
why.en: Interviews are the week of April 28, when she will be away.

questions.trap: Cô nói rõ đã quen làm cuối tuần và dùng phần mềm đặt chỗ.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: The deck is dark. A huge lion's mane jellyfish floats beside the ship, its red hair moving like a flame.
story.vi: Boong tàu tối. Một con sứa bờm sư tử khổng lồ trôi cạnh tàu, "bờm" đỏ lay động như ngọn lửa.

story.speaker: BAO
story.en: Beautiful, isn't it? Come, Huy. I want to show you something in my office.
story.vi: Đẹp không? Đi nào, Huy. Tôi muốn cho em xem cái này trong văn phòng.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: On the wall, a new sign: a letter A inside a wave. Under it, three words: ABYSSAL CORPORATION.
story.vi: Trên tường, một biển hiệu mới: chữ A trong làn sóng. Bên dưới là ba chữ: ABYSSAL CORPORATION.

story.speaker: HUY
story.en: Captain... the crates, the ledger, the guests. It was you. All of it was you.
story.vi: Thuyền trưởng... các thùng hàng, cuốn sổ, những vị khách. Là anh. Tất cả là anh.

story.speaker: BAO
story.en: I am a businessman, Huy. A jellyfish that never dies is worth more than gold. And you found the reef for me.
story.vi: Tôi là doanh nhân, Huy. Một con sứa không bao giờ chết đáng giá hơn vàng. Và em đã tìm ra rạn cho tôi.

story.speaker: HUY
story.en: I did not find it for you! Every message from M. was for me, not for your money!
story.vi: Em không tìm nó cho anh! Mỗi tin nhắn của M. là dành cho em, không phải cho tiền của anh!

story.speaker: BAO
story.en: Lock the door. He cannot leave until we reach the south reef.
story.vi: Khóa cửa lại. Cậu ta không được đi cho đến khi tới rạn phía nam.

story.speaker: BESUA
story.en: Dọ, Huy, em chui qua khe cửa nhỏ xíu nè! Chạy ra mũi tàu đi, có xuồng cứu sinh! Nhanh nhanh!
story.vi: Dạ Huy, em chui qua khe cửa nhỏ xíu nè! Chạy ra mũi tàu đi, có xuồng cứu sinh! Nhanh nhanh!

story.speaker: NOVA
story.en: Huy, I should have told you sooner. I cannot lie to you now. Take the lifeboat. I will guide you.
story.vi: Huy, lẽ ra tôi phải nói sớm hơn. Giờ tôi không thể nói dối bạn nữa. Lên xuồng cứu sinh. Tôi sẽ dẫn đường.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: Huy jumps into the lifeboat. Behind him, the Aurelia's lights turn red. The Captain is no longer a friend.
story.vi: Huy nhảy lên xuồng cứu sinh. Phía sau, đèn tàu Aurelia chuyển đỏ. Thuyền trưởng không còn là bạn nữa.

letter.vi: Bé iu, boss lớn rồi, nửa bài thi thật luôn! Mẹo Part 7: đọc câu hỏi trước, rồi FOLLOW (đi theo) từ khóa, nhưng đáp án hay dùng từ đồng nghĩa chứ không lặp y chang. Anh tự hào về bé rồi, hihii.
letter.en: My love, a big boss, half a real test! Part 7 tip: read the questions first, then FOLLOW the keywords, but the answer often uses a synonym instead of the same word. I am already proud of you, hihii.

beSua: Although + mệnh đề, despite + danh từ. "Although it rained", "despite the rain". Sai là mất điểm đó nha. Hihi. :33
Nghe Part 3-4: nếu đáp án lặp y chang từ trong audio, hay là bẫy. Đáp án thật thường đổi từ đồng nghĩa. Dọ!
Lion's mane jellyfish có xúc tu dài tới 30 mét. Hihi, dài ngang cá voi xanh nè! :33
